overview: The Medford City Council confirmed municipal board appointments, approved a $300,000 loan order for DPW facility cleanup costs, and passed a clarified outdoor dining ordinance. The Council also requested updates on Meadow Glen Mall redevelopment plans, traffic calming, and charter review legislation, and heard public comments regarding city facility maintenance and Community Preservation Act exemptions.

items.title: Confirmation of Board Appointments
items.summary: The Council confirmed the mayor's appointments of Dean Bruno to the License Commission and Nabin Sapkhoda as Commissioner of Trust Funds.

items.title: DPW Facility Loan Order
items.summary: The Council approved on third reading a $300,000 loan order addition for the DPW facility project to address underestimated soil contamination cleanup costs.

items.title: Outdoor Dining Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: An amended ordinance clarifying existing language for outdoor dining licenses passed its third and final reading.

items.title: Withdrawal of Paper 15-788
items.summary: Paper 15-788 was removed from the table and withdrawn by the sponsor as moot.

items.title: Parks Upgrades and Community Recognitions
items.summary: Councilors reviewed linkage-funded park renovation projects and passed resolutions congratulating local residents on a 50th wedding anniversary, a 90th birthday, and a regional CYO basketball championship.

items.title: War Memorial Maintenance
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting DPW cleaning and lighting repairs for city war memorials, as well as a complete monument inventory and maintenance schedule from the Veterans Services Director.

items.title: Meadow Glen Mall Redevelopment Meeting
items.summary: Passed a resolution to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting with city officials and developers to receive updates on the Meadow Glen Mall project.

items.title: Public Works and Communication Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting street depression repairs near the Brooks School, catch basin maintenance on Winthrop Avenue, and multi-channel public notifications for services such as street sweeping.

items.title: Veterans Advisory Council Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a status report from the mayor regarding member applications and appointments for the Veterans Advisory Council.

items.title: Forest Street Traffic Calming
items.summary: Referred requests for speed signage, raised crosswalks, crosswalk status updates, and speedometer equipment repairs on Forest Street and Governors Avenue to the Traffic Commission.

items.title: Charter Review Home Rule Petition Update
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting State Representative Paul Donato provide an update on the status of the city's Charter Review Home Rule Petition before the state legislature.

items.title: Dedication to Senator Charlie Shannon
items.summary: The Council dedicated the meeting and held a moment of silence in memory of former State Senator Charlie Shannon on the 11th anniversary of his passing.

items.title: Public Comment on Facilities and CPA Exemptions
items.summary: Placed on file citizen comments regarding city building maintenance and arts spaces, and passed a motion requesting the administration publicize and extend application deadlines for Community Preservation Act tax exemptions.

items.title: Dog Park Grant and Public Comment
items.summary: Received an update on a $250,000 grant application submitted to the Stanton Foundation for a municipal dog park, and heard public comment honoring the late tax activist Barbara Anderson.
